sections.fact: User mode exposes integer bank 0; privileged mode selects bank 1 only with RB set. R8-R15 are common.
DMULS produces a signed 64-bit product split into MACH and MACL.
LDC SR masks its operand with 0x700083F3. SR and alternate-bank accesses are privileged; alternate-bank instructions access the inactive integer bank.
Privileged operations in user mode fault; LDC SR in a delayed-branch slot is illegal.
FLDS transfers the selected FR word to FPUL.

qualification: The new operation layer reports typed pre-trap faults. Exception-vector delivery, interrupt acceptance and timing remain separate unfinished engine work.
